description: Convert between octal and symbolic Unix file permissions. Operations: "octal-to-symbolic" — Convert octal permissions (e.g. "755") to a symbolic string and description.; "symbolic-to-octal" — Convert a symbolic permission string (e.g. "rwxr-xr-x") to octal.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: octal-to-symbolic: Octal permission string, e.g. "755" or "0644". symbolic-to-octal: Symbolic permission string, e.g. "rwxr-xr-x".

operation.description: octal-to-symbolic — Convert octal permissions (e.g. "755") to a symbolic string and description. symbolic-to-octal — Convert a symbolic permission string (e.g. "rwxr-xr-x") to octal.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: chmod
